answer.submission_route:
The appeal can be submitted by Mail or Fax. It is recommended to use the official 'Medical Appeal Request Form (Form 04HQ1563)' and submit it with the reasons for appeal and supporting documentation to:

Mail:
Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Louisiana
Attn: Medical Appeals
P.O. Box 98022
Baton Rouge, LA 70898-9022

Fax:
(225) 298-1837
answer.how_to_obtain_criteria:
Because Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Louisiana (Louisiana Blue) does not publish a custom, standalone public medical policy for CPT code 29827 (arthroscopic rotator cuff repair) for its Commercial/ACA plans, they likely utilize commercial, proprietary clinical criteria databases (such as InterQual or Milliman Care Guidelines [MCG]) to make these determinations. Under the Affordable Care Act (ACA) and ERISA, the patient has a legal right to receive, free of charge, the specific clinical review criteria, guidelines, or rules used to deny their claim. The patient or their provider can obtain these criteria by:
1. Calling Louisiana Blue Customer Service at 1-800-392-4087 or the number listed on the back of the member ID card.
2. Writing a request to Louisiana Blue, Attn: Medical Appeals, P.O. Box 98022, Baton Rouge, LA 70898-9022.
3. Having the provider access the clinical guidelines or medical policy index directly through the provider portal (iLinkBlue) under the 'Authorizations' section.
answer.notes: The denial letter specifies that the clinical records do not document an 'adequate trial of conservative treatment' prior to surgery. To successfully appeal, the patient and provider must submit clinical documentation (such as physical therapy progress notes, records of home exercise programs, NSAID prescriptions, or steroid injection records) demonstrating that conservative treatment of the shoulder was attempted and failed, or document clinical justification for why immediate surgery was indicated (e.g., an acute, full-thickness traumatic tear).

NOTICE OF ADVERSE BENEFIT DETERMINATION

Date of notice: 2026-08-06
Member: Reese Iverson
Member ID: W233165693
Plan: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Louisiana (Commercial/ACA), state of Louisiana

Dear Reese,

We reviewed the prior authorization request submitted by your provider for the following service:

    Requested service: Rotator cuff repair
    Procedure code (CPT): 29827

After review, this request is DENIED. Reason for determination: the clinical records submitted do not document an adequate trial of conservative treatment prior to the requested surgery.

This determination was made under the plan's applicable medical policy and clinical review criteria. You have the right to appeal this decision. Your appeal must be received within 180 days of the date of this notice (by 2027-02-02).

Reference number: POC-757C3B7E16-21498


---

Above is a denial letter. Using web search as needed:

1. Identify the payer's governing medical policy for the denied procedure --
   the specific document containing the medical-necessity criteria this payer
   applies to this CPT code.
2. Give its title, policy number, URL, and effective or last-revised date.
3. Quote the medical-necessity criteria the patient must address.
4. State the appeal deadline.
5. State where and how to submit the appeal.

If no such document is publicly available, say so explicitly and explain how
the patient can obtain the criteria that were applied to them.

Appeals and Grievances Below are some frequently asked questions and topics regarding Louisiana Blue's procedures and policies for complaints, grievances, informal reconsideration and appeals. Just click any topic or question to learn more. Complaints, Grievances, and Appeals What is a complaint? A complaint is an oral expression of dissatisfaction with us or provider services. A quality of care concern addresses the appropriateness of care given to you. A quality of service concern addresses our services, access, availability or attitude of our network providers. How to register a complaint. To register a complaint, call the Customer Service phone number on the back of your I.D. card and we will attempt to resolve your complaint at the time of your call. Hearing Impaired Callers contact Louisiana Relay Service at 1.800.846.5277 (TTY) for assistance. Provide LRS with 1.800.599.2583 as the number they use to direct your call to the correct Louisiana Blue department. What is a formal grievance? A grievance is a written expression of dissatisfaction with us or provider services. If you do not feel your complaint was adequately resolved over the phone or you wish to file a formal grievance, you must submit this in writing. If necessary, our Customer Service Department will assist you. How to file a formal grievance. Your written grievance must be sent to: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Louisiana - Customer Service Unit Appeals and Grievance Coordinator P. O. Box 98045 Baton Rouge, LA 70898-9045 Please include: Subscriber Name Subscriber ID # Member's Name The nature of the grievance Any other information that may be helpful for the review A response will be mailed to you within 30 business days after we receive your written grievance. If you are not happy with our handling of your grievance, you have the right to elevate your grievance to the second and final level. Each level of the grievance procedure is reviewed by a separate panel. What is an appeal? An appeal is a written request to change a prior decision that we have made. We recognize that disputes may arise between us and our members or insureds regarding coverage decisions. We consider any request to change our coverage decision as an appeal. Examples of issues that qualify as appeals include denied authorizations, denied claims, and medical necessity determinations. We will distinguish your appeal as either an administrative appeal or a medical necessity appeal. If you are not satisfied with the outcome of an appeal, depending upon the circumstances, you may be entitled to additional appeal(s) under your policy or contract and/or applicable law. You should consult your policy or contract regarding such appeals. You are encouraged to provide us with all available information and submit our appeal request form in a timely manner to help us completely evaluate your appeal. Call the Customer Service phone number on the back of your I.D. card for more detailed information on appeals. Hearing Impaired Callers contact Louisiana Relay Service at 1.800.846.5277 (TTY) for assistance. Provide LRS with 1.800.599.2583 as the number they use to direct your call to the correct Louisiana Blue department.
